correctness.rationale: Identifying R^2 with C, one S-SEG step multiplies by m_s=1-sγ+i(2sγ^2-γ). Exact multiplication gives |m_+|^2|m_-|^2=16γ^8-4γ^4+1. The iid strong law gives the mean log-modulus exponent, whose sign changes exactly at γ=1/sqrt(2). At equality the moduli are sqrt(2)-1 and sqrt(2)+1, so the log radius is a centered simple random walk with unbounded positive and negative excursions. Averaging the two squared moduli gives 1+2γ^2+4γ^4. The frozen verifier and a fresh independent polynomial check reproduce these identities.
